description: This bar chart illustrates the accuracy scores for three different sentiment analysis tools—TEXTBLOB, VADER, and ChatGPT—when applied to two distinct tweet categories: “Emoji Tweets” and “Overall Tweets.” The horizontal axis displays the tweet categories, labeled “Emoji Tweets” and “Overall Tweet,” and is categorical with no defined order. The vertical axis represents “Accuracy,” with a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.8, with tick marks at 0.2 intervals. For each category, there are three bars representing the accuracy of each tool; TEXTBLOB bars are white with black hatching, VADER bars are solid green, and ChatGPT bars are dark green. In the “Emoji Tweets” category, the TEXTBLOB bar reaches approximately 0.42, the VADER bar reaches approximately 0.64, and the ChatGPT bar reaches approximately 0.73. In the “Overall Tweet” category, the TEXTBLOB bar reaches approximately 0.48, the VADER bar reaches approximately 0.63, and the ChatGPT bar reaches approximately 0.71. The bars are grouped by category, with each tool’s accuracy represented side-by-side within each group. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
